answer: Spot-audit lottery: each identity posts a 100-credit bond; each epoch a public beacon draws 10% for audit. Auditors check funding and history on the ferrous ledger; rented trails fail the key match. Results go on the meadow register; a fake with no real trail burns its bond and freezes its cluster. 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 and burn 10,000 per epoch, against a pool share under 4,000, a steady loss. Honest identities post one bond once and keep it.
